# asciipaper engine

> A GPU renderer that turns one GLSL function into a wall of characters, for walls of text
> on a desktop or a browser canvas. Native C (Wayland layer-shell, OpenGL ES) and a WebGL 1
> runtime that runs the same shaders and specs.

## What it does

You write `vec4 cell(vec2 uv)` returning a colour and a 0..1 brightness. The engine runs it
once per character cell, maps brightness to a glyph from a ramp, and draws each cell in its
own colour. The CPU only sets uniforms per frame.

## Quick start

- Build: `make` (produces `native/asciipaper-engine`).
- Live wallpaper: `./native/asciipaper-engine plasma`
- One frame: `./native/asciipaper-engine --spec wallpapers/specs/tunnel.json --lib wallpapers/lib --snapshot out.png --size 1920x1080 --seconds 6`
- Browser: `python3 -m http.server -d wallpapers 8000`, then `/run.html?spec=specs/plasma.json`
- Tests: `make test`

## Layout

- `native/` — the C renderer: Wayland layer-shell output per monitor, spec loader, GLSL
  cell pass and glyph pass, PNG/video recording, pointer input.
- `wallpapers/lib/asciipaper.js` — the WebGL 1 renderer (frame pacing, pointer, atlas,
  cell/glyph passes), `looks.json` with the shape, charset, dither, palette and effect tables,
  `media.glsl` for imported media, `legacy.js` for the four built-in interactive scenes.
- `wallpapers/specs/` — example wallpapers as JSON + GLSL.
- `wallpapers/run.html` — a page that runs one spec.
- `tools/generate_runtime.py` — generates `native/shaders.h`, `wallpapers/lib/legacy.js` and
  the catalogs so the native and web renderers never drift.

## Specs

A wallpaper is JSON (`title`, `shader`, `charset`, `cell`, `aspect`, `fill`, `background`,
optionally `shape`, `dither`, `palette`, `effects`, `interaction`, `speed`, `pace`, `weight`,
`maxCells`, `color`). A shader's first line may be `// defaults: {...}` to declare uniforms.
`cell(uv)` reads `u_time`, `u_aspect`, `u_grid`, `u_size`, `u_pointer`, `u_velocity`,
`u_down`, `u_strength`, `u_idle`, `u_clicks[8]`, `u_data`, and returns `vec4(rgb, level)`.
Shaders are GLSL ES 1.0.
